gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/concern/config-files/manifest.toml)

Every data and configuration file no language owns: JSON, TOML, YAML, workflows, environment files, plists and XML, each parsed and linted by the tool for its format.

Kind: concern. Requires: `formatting`. Selected by default.

## Tools

- taplo 0.10.0
- yamllint 1.38.0
- v8r 6.1.0
- actionlint 1.7.12
- pinact 5.0.0
- zizmor 1.30.1
- dotenv-linter 4.0.0
- plutil
- xmllint

## Generated configuration

- `.gspot/taplo.toml`
- `.gspot/yamllint.yml`
- `.gspot/v8r.yml`

## Checks

| Check                                                                              | Stage  | What it finds                                                                                                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [`config-files/json`](/reference/rules/config-files/json/)                         | commit | Parses and formats every JSON file through Prettier.                                                                                                         |
| [`config-files/toml`](/reference/rules/config-files/toml/)                         | commit | Parses every TOML file with taplo; the schema check runs at push through v8r.                                                                                |
| [`config-files/toml-format`](/reference/rules/config-files/toml-format/)           | commit | Checks that every TOML file is formatted the way taplo formats it with the shared settings.                                                                  |
| [`config-files/yaml`](/reference/rules/config-files/yaml/)                         | commit | Parses every YAML file and checks its indentation, keys, and values with yamllint.                                                                           |
| [`config-files/schema`](/reference/rules/config-files/schema/)                     | push   | Validates every configuration file that has a known schema against it: package.json, tsconfig.json, mise, workflows and the rest of the SchemaStore catalog. |
| [`config-files/actions`](/reference/rules/config-files/actions/)                   | commit | Checks every GitHub Actions workflow with actionlint: syntax, expressions, action inputs, and shell steps.                                                   |
| [`config-files/actions-pins`](/reference/rules/config-files/actions-pins/)         | push   | Verifies GitHub action commits and version comments without changing workflow files.                                                                         |
| [`config-files/actions-security`](/reference/rules/config-files/actions-security/) | commit | Audits every GitHub Actions workflow with zizmor: template injection, unpinned actions, excessive permissions, dangerous triggers.                           |
| [`config-files/dotenv`](/reference/rules/config-files/dotenv/)                     | commit | Checks every tracked environment file: key format, duplicates, quoting, ordering, and trailing spaces.                                                       |
| [`config-files/env-example`](/reference/rules/config-files/env-example/)           | push   | Checks that every environment variable the code reads appears in the environment template.                                                                   |
| [`config-files/plist`](/reference/rules/config-files/plist/)                       | commit | Parses every property list and entitlements file with plutil.                                                                                                |
| [`config-files/xml`](/reference/rules/config-files/xml/)                           | commit | Parses every XML file, storyboard, and xib with xmllint.                                                                                                     |

## Settings

- `tools.yamllint.rules`: Options per yamllint rule, by rule name; turning a rule off is gspot ignore --rule.
- `tools.taplo.rules`: Formatting options taplo takes, by option name, on top of the shared [format] settings.
- `tools.v8r.schemas`: File patterns mapped to schema URLs, for files the SchemaStore catalog does not know; each entry has a pattern and a schema.
- `tools.dotenv.templates`: The environment template files every key the code reads must appear in.
- `tools.dotenv.accessor`: The name of the function the code reads environment variables through, on top of process.env and os.environ; empty means those two alone.
